resolvedFindings.finding: A plane perpendicular to the lateral edges need not intersect all finite edge segments in an arbitrary inclined prism.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Construction now explicitly permits edge and face extensions; distances supply the corresponding parallelogram heights. Independently reread both corrected proofs.

resolvedFindings.finding: The conditional corrected example used an unexplained dot-product method.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Now translates AC1 to CE and proves triangle CEB1 equilateral using three square diagonals. New E and the three equal lengths independently checked.

resolvedFindings.finding: Initial D=(2,8√2,0) did not lie on BC.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Author corrected D=(6,8√2,0); independent checks verify incidence, angle bisection, BD:DC=2:3 and AD=8√6.

sourceExceptions.finding: All lateral faces square force an equilateral base, incompatible with the printed isosceles right base.
sourceExceptions.handling: Literal answer is no nondegenerate prism. A separately labelled conditional correction (only faces above the two legs square) explains the60° example. Model caption and steps explicitly exclude full literal fulfillment.
